description: This file is an HTML web page that provides a user interface for visualizing database contents, allowing users to browse databases, their tables, and view table data in a tabular format with interactive features.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading databases from the backend API and updating the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates the HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates the HTML for individual table cells, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability.
